name: Tonner Drones
summary: Tonner Drones S.A. specializes in the creation of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) and associated technologies, serving both military applications and homeland security requirements. Beyond these strategic sectors, the company also delivers professional drone services to civilian clients across a diverse international footprint, including France, Belgium, Morocco, South Africa, Ghana, and Australia. Their product offerings encompass the ISS SPOTTER Tethered, designed for temporary security oversight, and the ISS SPOTTER Automatic, an autonomous, boxed surveillance drone solution. They also provide COUNTBOT, an inventory management drone system aimed at improving stock accuracy, and SPOTTER BOT, a versatile mobile video security platform suitable for various environments like construction sites, industrial facilities, major events, and traffic monitoring. Initially established in 2011 as Delta Drone SA, the company adopted its current name, Tonner Drones S.A., in October 2023. Its operational base is located in Cannes, France.
